main_text.p: votam, ac poenam incurrerent. Quod quidem ideo narro tantum, ut manifestum fiat injuriam fieri Ecclesiae Genevensi ab adversariis, non autem, ut consuetudinem aut ordinem particularem ullius Eccle-siae oppugnem; aut impedire velim vel hac in parte, vel in aliis rebus, quas hactenus expoluimus quò minus Magistratus de jure suo si vult, remittat, quâ in parte quid expediat ipsius est prudenter di-spicere. Atque hæc in præsentia-rum sufficiant de hac materia. Pii Reges ac Magistratus facile vident se causam omnem habere, tum Deo gratias agendi, quod in libertatem suam per doctrinam Eu-angelii ex superbissimo jugo Cle-ri Romani sint vindicati; tum hanc doctrinam Ecclesiarum Refor-matarum tanquam insignem gem-mam diadematum ac fulcrum thro-norum suorum sollicitè in Eccle-clesiâ conservandi. Ira enim &c

page.notes: The first word "uotam" is a fragment cut at the top of the page; I read it as "votam" per the u/v rule, but the first letter is uncertain and could be checked against the previous page. The line "in_ li-" carries a small mark after "in" that looks like a printer's ornament or damage; I have read it as "in libertatem". The running head "Q. XIII." is printed at the top right and is included here as the quaestio heading. The printed "&c" is copied as "&c" in XML. The catchword "illis" is at the lower right and is not part of the text.
